property_summary: For every input, C.transfer(...) never reverts (returns true) because it only indexes _tos[i] for i in 0.._tos.length-1; the mutant that uses i <= _tos.length can cause an out-of-bounds access and thus sometimes revert for some non-empty _tos — so the property: calling transfer(...) always succeeds (does not revert).
change_summary: Change loop condition to allow one extra iteration (i <= _tos.length) which will cause an out-of-bounds access and likely revert when _tos.length > 0.
